observed.caption: A person in a dark suit and striped tie stands with a hand on their chest and mouth open in a warmly lit indoor space.
observed.description: In the foreground a person wearing a dark suit jacket, light blue collared shirt, and a red, white, and blue diagonally striped tie stands with the left hand placed on the chest and mouth open. A small light-colored pin is on the left lapel and a dark wristband with a metallic section is on the left wrist. Behind to the right a blurred person is visible, behind to the left another blurred person is visible, and a partial dark shape of another person appears on the far left edge. The background is out of focus with warm-toned wooden architectural elements and soft indoor lighting.
